spellbook.finance/limitations: This tool cannot pair an extension. Pairing mints a long-lived token that the extension uses to act on TCGplayer for the seller, so only the seller creates it by clicking the button on the pairing page. Never ask the seller to paste a pairing token into chat.
extensionAccess not_enabled means this account is not in the TCGplayer extension beta. Pairing is unavailable until SpellBook support enables it.
The extension installs from a download on the guide page and loads as an unpacked Chrome extension. It is not in the Chrome Web Store.
A session with status active and a null lastSeenAt was created, but the extension has not checked in. The seller may not have finished loading the extension.
Workspace membership is backend-enforced. A paired extension does not prove any TCGplayer listing is live.

description: Read whether this workspace has a paired TCGplayer browser extension, and get the SpellBook page where the seller pairs one. TCGplayer has no seller API, so SpellBook syncs TCGplayer listings and orders through a Chrome extension on the seller's own computer. Returns whether the account has extension access, the current session's status, when it was paired, when the extension last checked in, and its order sync state. If session is null or lastSeenAt is null, give the seller pairingPage.guideUrl to install the extension, then pairingPage.url to pair it. Call this tool again after they finish.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to read extension pairing for, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_tcg_extension_pairing
